title: Setting up a liquid culture and harvesting C.elegans
author: Vidur Sabharwal
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xcpfivn
materials: Aspirate most of the liquid from the flask.

steps.title: Prepare Worm Plates
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 L4 hermaphrodites each to 10 90cm plates and incubate at 20 °C for approximately 144:00:00 (6 days) until they are almost starved.

steps.title: Prepare Liquid Culture Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare S Medium in a sterilized 250 ml flask and inoculate with E. coli OP50.

substeps.instruction: Add 30ml S Medium to the flask.
Inoculate with a concentrated E. coli OP50 pellet to a final concentration of 30g/L.

steps.title: Inoculate Worms into Culture
steps.instruction: Transfer C. elegans from plates into the prepared S Medium.

substeps.instruction: Wash 5 large plates (90cm) of C. elegans (cleared of bacteria) with 5 ml S Medium each.
Add the washed worms to the 30 ml flask.

steps.title: Incubate Liquid Culture
steps.instruction: Incubate the flask on a shaker at 200rpm and 20 °C for 84:00:00.

steps.title: Harvest Worms
steps.instruction: Settle and pellet the worms from the liquid culture.

substeps.instruction: Put the flask on ice for 00:15:00 to allow worms to settle.
Transfer the remaining liquid to a 15 ml borosil conical tube using a glass pasteur pipette.
Spin for at least 2 min (00:02:00) at 500 × g to pellet the worms (note: young larvae may require longer than 2 min).

steps.title: Wash Worms
steps.instruction: Wash the worm pellet to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the remaining liquid.
Wash with 10x volume of M9 twice.
Spin for at least 2 min at 500 × g after each wash to pellet the worms.

steps.title: Perform Sucrose Float Purification
steps.instruction: Purify worms using a sucrose gradient to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend animals in 20 ml of ice-cold M9 lacking MgSO4.
Add 20 ml of ice-cold 60 % sucrose in H2O and mix vigorously.
Gently layer 4 ml of ice-cold M9 lacking MgSO4 on top.
Centrifuge at 400 g for 2 min at 4 °C (perform steps quickly to ensure proper layer formation).

steps.title: Recover and Clean Worms
steps.instruction: Recover the purified worm layer and remove intestinal bacteria.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 30 ml of supernatant from the sucrose float.
Distribute the supernatant into four 50 ml tubes and fill the remainder of the tubes with room-temperature M9 lacking MgSO4 to allow digestion of OP50 bacteria.
Place the four tubes on ice for 30 min to cool down.
Wash the animals twice in M9 buffer.

steps.title: Prepare Final Pellet for Storage
steps.instruction: Concentrate the worms and stabilize them in IP Buffer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the worms to a 1.5ml eppendorf and incubate on ice for 10 mins (00:10:00).
Remove as much supernatant as possible.
Add IP Buffer to the pellet at a ratio of 2 parts homogenization buffer : 1 part worm pellet.
Store at -80C for up to 3 months.
